config.sunbathing.enabled.tooltip: Light shafts from the sun and the moon.
config.sunbathing.sun_intensity.tooltip: How bright the sun rays are.
config.sunbathing.moon_intensity.tooltip: How bright the moon rays are.
config.sunbathing.quality.tooltip: Higher looks smoother but is slower.
config.sunbathing.density.tooltip: How far the rays stretch out from the sun.
config.sunbathing.decay.tooltip: Lower makes the rays fade out sooner.
config.sunbathing.lens_flare.tooltip: Flare when looking at the sun. 0 turns it off.
config.sunbathing.shadows_enabled.toolti: Blocks and mobs cast shadows from the sun and moon. Still experimental and quite heavy.
config.sunbathing.shadow_pixelation.tool: Makes shadow edges blocky. 0 keeps them smooth, 16 matches the block grid.
config.sunbathing.dof.tooltip: Blurs things farther away than what you are looking at. 0 turns it off.
config.sunbathing.dof_range.tooltip: How many blocks past your focus point stay sharp before the blur kicks in.
